The main takeaway from our work is that
parents are important influences on children's health behaviours and that parents can influence their children's health behaviours.

parents' confidence in being able to influence their children's eating and physical activity behaviours is associated with children's eating and activity behaviours, and declines during the first few months of a child's early life.
